newsitem.title: ESTONIA: RAKVERE'S MAY NET PROFIT 2.2 MLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: RAKVERE'S MAY NET PROFIT 2.2 MLN KROONS.

text.p: Rakvere meat plant's net profit for May was 2.2 million kroons and its turnover was 51.9 million kroons, the company said on Friday.
Rakvere said in a statement that its turnover increased by 9.5 percent compared to the same period last year.
In the first five months of 1997 the meat processor said that its net turnover was 238.6 million kroons. Compared to the same period in 1996 turnover increased by 17.2 percent.
Compared to the first five months of 1996 production of finished products in 1997 increased by 14 percent and the production of semi-processed products increased by eight percent.
